tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: The devices Drisp can put a screenshot on, each with the screenshot size in pixels that fills its screen exactly (portrait for phones, tablets and watches) and its page on drint.io.

tools.name: device_mockup
tools.description: Put a screenshot of an app or website on a device mockup and get a PNG. The screenshot fills the screen edge to edge (cropped to the screen's shape if its proportions differ). Give the screenshot as screenshot_url (a public https link) or screenshot_base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 10 MB).
